issues: When `seed=None`, `random.Random(None)` creates a new local generator seeded with the current system time, which ignores any seed that might have been previously set on the global `random` module. It is better to fall back to using the global `random` module when `seed=None` to ensure reproducibility if a caller relies on a global seed.
